the content of viral advertisement has a positive effect on brand attitude and purchase intentions, and that these effects are moderated by culture.
The global viral advertisements are effective in influencing the consumers to share them with other people and to purchase the advertised product.
the global advertising strategy should be standardized and should be customized to a particular culture.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to make the viral advertisements effective across cultures.
the effects of global viral advertising content on consumers' attitudes towards the brands and their intentions to share the corresponding ads.
the development of a framework to model the effects of the elements of global viral advertising content.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the global viral advertising content should not be standardized, but it should be modified to suit the culture of a particular country, as the content analysis results show the differences in the content of the advertisements across the two countries.
, the advertisers should use a standardized advertising strategy across the globe, as the content of global viral advertisements is similar and effective across the globe.
the content of the advertisements is not a mere tool to convey a message to a particular audience but it also has an influence on their attitude, intentions and purchase decisions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the content of global advertisement is a mixture of the dominating elements of different cultures and it is important to understand how these elements are used to make the content viral.
, although a standardized advertising approach may be used for the global market, but it is important to customize the content in compliance with cultural uniqueness in different countries.
although there is a standardized advertising strategy, but it should be customized according to the cultural differences of different countries.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the advertisers need to understand that a standardized advertising strategy may not work for every country and they need to understand the cultural nuances in order to be successful in their advertising campaign.

the content analysis of global viral advertisements is a useful technique to understand the cultural differences in the advertising content across different cultures and can be used as a tool for the advertisers to develop their marketing content accordingly.
advertisers should be careful about using standardized advertising strategies across the globe, and should be more sensitive to the cultural differences across the different countries.
